description: An en catalog whose bytes begin with the UTF-8 BOM EF BB BF, and a byte-identical fr catalog without it. Supplied through rawFilesBase64 because a BOM cannot survive being written from a JSON object. normalizeLocalizedStringsFileContents strips a leading U+FEFF before the JSON parser ever sees it; a port that decodes UTF-8 without BOM handling fails to parse the en file entirely.
